facts.fact: Al-Watwan reports Comoros has a national data governance strategy, validated at a 24-25 August 2026 Moroni workshop, whose first axis is data sovereignty, with the State seeking to control the production, storage, circulation, use and protection of administration data.
facts.system: Stratégie nationale de gouvernance des données

facts.fact: Al-Watwan reports the recent opening of the first data centre of the public administration, which minister Oumouri Mmadi Hassani calls an important advance for digital sovereignty.
facts.system: premier data center de l'administration publique
